page.overview:
Who is Bergs?

Bergs are covered in white fur, and wear brown cloth scraps around their pelvis, forearms, and shins, suggesting some level of sentience. They also have something on their face resembling what is on Rynokk's, but with horns instead of tubes on either side; it is unknown whether this is some sort of apparatus, or a natural part of their faces.

A number of Bergs also appear later in the Battle Nexus.
